title: How John Rush got to 500k users: 23 marketing channels, what worked and what failed
summary: John Rush reviews every channel he tried while growing Unicorn Platform to 500k users (4 years to 25k, 2 years to 250k, 6 months to 500k). Passive channels like directories, SEO, Reddit, LinkedIn and affiliates worked. Ads, cold email, giveaways, LTDs and incubator deals failed. Product quality drives word of mouth.

principles.text: Directories are one of the best channels: they bring traffic on autopilot.
principles.quote: One of the best channels I have. Sometimes I think I should quit marketing and just build directories. Because they bring traffic on autopilot.

principles.text: Ads and cold email fail when you promote the product directly. Hide the product behind a freebie.
principles.quote: simply promoting your product with ads never really works. U need to create a freebie or be genius at banners.

principles.text: Start SEO early; ignoring it until 2023 was his biggest mistake. Mix AI-generated and human-made articles.
principles.quote: I didn't touch it until April 2023; it was my biggest mistake.

principles.text: Affiliate programs need a generous cut. Raising commission from 15% to 33% made it work.
principles.quote: I started with 15% and had no interest. Changed to 33% and it picked up.

principles.text: Multiple side projects cross-promote: at least 10% of users came from his other products, even free ones.
principles.quote: At least 10% of all my users came from my other products. So, having multiple side projects isn't a bad idea.

principles.text: Product quality and empathy for users drive growth, because most users arrive by word of mouth.
principles.quote: Most users come via word of mouth, and people only recommend products they love. I put a lot of effort into making the product better.
